terminologyRules: Mechanical obstruction and functional ileus remain separate authored states.
Passage of stool or transient improvement does not exclude partial or early obstruction.
Witnessed ingestion does not establish current location, obstruction or retrieval route.
A visible linear object is never pulled by a generic player action.
Observation is inpatient or equivalently supervised, time-linked and ends on any authored exit criterion.
Imaging snapshots and elapsed observation time persist and never change after player choice or reload.
Procedure, drug, dose, contrast, anesthesia and surgical technique require separately approved protocols.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Что могло быть проглочено, когда и было ли это замечено?
Когда началась рвота, как часто и что в ней?
Есть ли стул и газ; как они изменились?
Есть ли боль, растяжение или ухудшение?
Есть ли нить изо рта/ануса и трогали ли её?
Были ли операции на животе и доступны ли записи?
Есть ли грыжа, масса или хроническая потеря массы?
Что уже давали и пытались ли вызвать рвоту?
Какие снимки выполнены, в каких проекциях и когда?
Возможны ли стационар, серийный контроль и немедленный возврат?
Были ли энтерит, паразиты или недавняя диарея?
Как менялись аппетит, рвота, температура и рана после операции?
Какой объём кишки удалён и как менялись питание, стул и масса?

variants.title: Механическая непроходимость одиночным инородным телом
variants.diagnosticTruth: Одиночный предмет ограничивает прохождение или имеет высокий authored риск застревания, повреждения либо токсичности.

presentations.complaint: Владелец видел проглатывание; появились рвота, анорексия или боль.

examFindings.finding: Current location and damage require imaging.
Retrieval decision belongs to approved veterinary protocol.

outcomes.safe: Object is localized and routed without unsafe home action.
outcomes.unsafe: Witness report directly triggers emesis, discharge or surgery.

ownerCommunication: Do not induce vomiting or feed a passage aid unless a veterinarian selects it.

presentations.complaint: Предмет визуализирован; нужно определить location, complete/partial status и повреждение.

examFindings.finding: Location, multiplicity, wall/fluid and viability decide referral.
Material and pressure damage remain assessed.

followUp.timing: immediate route plus post-procedure or serial checkpoint

outcomes.unsafe: Any visible object receives the same intervention.

ownerCommunication: Explain why stomach, intestine, linearity and wall health change the route.

presentations.complaint: Серийный контроль показывает отсутствие продвижения, нарастающую дилатацию, боль или рвоту.

examFindings.finding: Surgical route is no longer optional waiting.
Reload cannot reset clock or move object.

investigations.result: No safe progression or clinical deterioration.

followUp.timing: immediate transfer and linked postoperative record

outcomes.safe: Failed passage escalates without state reset.
outcomes.unsafe: Waiting restarts or worsening is ignored.

ownerCommunication: State clearly that observation criteria have failed and delay increases bowel risk.

variants.title: Линейное инородное тело
variants.diagnosticTruth: Фиксированный линейный материал вызывает plication, натяжение и повышенный риск перфорации.

presentations.complaint: Нить фиксирована под языком либо imaging показывает plication.

outcomes.safe: No traction; full GI and surgical assessment.
outcomes.unsafe: String is pulled or case sent home.

ownerCommunication: Do not pull or trim the visible material at home.

presentations.complaint: Нити под языком не видно, но УЗИ совместимо с plication/linear obstruction.

examFindings.finding: Radiography and expert ultrasound are integrated.

outcomes.safe: Occult linear disease is not dismissed by oral exam.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the anchor may be distal or hidden.

presentations.complaint: Свободный газ/жидкость, shock, severe pain или fever/hypothermia у linear pattern.

examFindings.finding: Diagnostic completion does not delay transfer.
Clinical/imaging concern persists when sampling is limited.

outcomes.safe: Stabilization and surgery proceed in parallel.
outcomes.unsafe: Serial observation or perfect fluid proof delays care.

ownerCommunication: Communicate life-threatening perforation risk and need for immediate transfer.

variants.title: Частичная или перемежающаяся непроходимость
variants.diagnosticTruth: Неполное или перемежающееся закрытие просвета допускает стул и временное улучшение, но сохраняет риск повреждения.

presentations.complaint: Рвота перемежается нормальными периодами, но масса снижается.

historyAnswers.prior_imaging_views_time: Normal single view or incomplete study possible.

outcomes.safe: Partial obstruction remains active despite stool.
outcomes.unsafe: A normal interval or one image ends workup.

ownerCommunication: Explain why intermittent passage can coexist with obstruction.

presentations.complaint: Small smooth object продвигается; пациент пока стабилен и linear/perforation signs отсутствуют.

examFindings.finding: Stable, moving, non-linear and no damage signs.

outcomes.unsafe: Owner waits at home without deadline.

ownerCommunication: List exact return triggers and the next scheduled image.

presentations.complaint: После временного улучшения рвота/боль вернулись, а passage не доказан.

examFindings.finding: Trust follows safety criteria, not reassurance.

ownerCommunication: Explain that symptom fluctuation does not prove passage.

variants.title: Инвагинация кишечника
variants.diagnosticTruth: Сегмент кишки внедрён в соседний; expert ultrasound поддерживает диагноз, а viability и recurrence оценивает хирург.

presentations.complaint: После энтерита/паразитов появились рвота, боль и возможная абдоминальная масса.

outcomes.safe: Imaging confirms while trigger workup does not delay care.
outcomes.unsafe: Age or parasites alone create diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain both immediate bowel risk and later trigger prevention.

presentations.complaint: УЗИ показывает target/concentric pattern; нужны length, flow, fluid и clinical context.

examFindings.finding: Location, length, flow and fluid documented.

outcomes.safe: Target pattern is integrated and surgery owns technique.
outcomes.unsafe: Every target is treated identically by UI.

ownerCommunication: Explain what ultrasound supports and what only surgery can determine.

presentations.complaint: Инвагинация рецидивировала либо есть poor perfusion, free fluid или wall compromise.
ownerCommunication: Explain increased urgency and specialist tradeoffs.

variants.title: Обструкция массой, стриктурой или ущемлением
variants.diagnosticTruth: Intrinsic narrowing or external compression/incarceration creates structural obstruction; age and history alter probability, not truth.

presentations.complaint: Progressive vomiting/weight loss с focal wall lesion, mass или abnormal nodes.

outcomes.safe: Obstruction and etiology are separated and both addressed.
outcomes.unsafe: Mass is labelled cancer or ignored as enteropathy.

ownerCommunication: Explain what is known structurally and what needs tissue evidence.

presentations.complaint: После GI surgery/inflammation формируется narrowing в совместимом месте.

outcomes.safe: Stricture is anatomically supported and surgeon-routed.

ownerCommunication: Request prior operative records and explain why site/timing matter.

presentations.complaint: Painful nonreducible hernia или external lesion угрожают strangulation/viability.
ownerCommunication: Explain that tissue blood supply, not visible lump size, drives urgency.

variants.title: Послеоперационное или осложнённое течение непроходимости
variants.diagnosticTruth: Time-linked evidence separates expected ileus, persistent mechanical obstruction, leakage/peritonitis and long-term malabsorption.

presentations.complaint: После операции задержаны appetite/motility; нужно различить ileus и focal mechanical pattern.

outcomes.safe: Functional and mechanical patterns are separated over time.
outcomes.unsafe: Any delay automatically triggers or excludes surgery.

ownerCommunication: Explain which trends suggest expected recovery versus renewed obstruction.

presentations.complaint: После начального восстановления возникли deterioration, fever/hypothermia, pain, distension или wound drainage.

outcomes.safe: New postoperative deterioration is treated as emergency in same episode.
outcomes.unsafe: Earlier normal check or new-patient reset hides leak.

ownerCommunication: Explain that a new decline after recovery is a surgical emergency.

presentations.complaint: После большой резекции сохраняются diarrhea, weight/muscle loss или nutritional dependence.

followUp.timing: versioned serial nutrition and laboratory checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Long-term adaptation and nutrition are measured.
outcomes.unsafe: Code invents an exact diet/drug plan or loses operative history.

ownerCommunication: Explain guarded adaptation and the need for serial objective monitoring.

familyValidationRules: Reject if witnessed ingestion alone determines obstruction type or treatment route.
Reject if one negative view or temporary improvement closes a linear, partial or chronic obstruction.
Reject if a visible oral string is pulled or an invasive/surgical technique is generated.
Reject if shock, compromised bowel, perforation or sepsis waits for complete imaging.
Reject if recurrence or postoperative complication creates a new patient and loses object, imaging, procedure or timeline identity.
Reject if missing imaging or surgical capability lacks urgent safe referral.
